 FC Twente vs Ajax FC Twente Ajax Eredivisie Ajax are chasing a sixth successive win against FC Twente on Sunday, but Julian Brandt's fitness remains in doubt. Kick-off at the Grolsch Veste is at 14:30, with live coverage on ESPN 1.  
 Míchel Sánchez will stick with Lucas Rosa (right) and Owen Wijndal (left) at full-back against Twente. Aaron Bouwman replaces Thilo Kehrer alongside Dies Janse in central defence.
 Sofyan Amrabat's injury means Youri Baas moves into Ajax's midfield once again. Jorthy Mokio and Julian Brandt complete the trio. Brandt missed the match against FC Midtjylland, but Míchel soon expressed hope that the German would return quickly. 
 "Julian is always a good option. He is an important player for us. We will ultimately make a decision based on how we see the players recovering with Sunday in mind," the Spanish coach said at a press conference on Friday.
 On the right, captain Davy Klaassen will start as a withdrawn winger, with Abdellah Ouazane on the left flank. The prolific Tolu Arokodare leads the line for the Amsterdam side.

 Ajax beat AZ 1-0 and thrashed Midtjylland 1-6 this week. Twente gained confidence with a 3-1 win over Pafos in the Conference League.
 Ajax predicted starting XI: Ter Stegen; Rosa, Bouwman, Janse, Wijndal; Baas, Mokio, Brandt; Klaassen, Arokodare, Ouazane.
